title: Plan the separately approved live Vault/EKS prepare and deploy sequence
expected_outcome: A reviewable, fail-closed operational sequence for a future live Vault prepare/deploy, including exact approval boundaries, validation evidence, and post-bootstrap privilege revocation.
constraints: This task creates a plan only: no Terraform apply, AWS/EKS/Vault/Kubernetes access, CodeBuild invocation, Vault initialization, secret operation, deployment, publication, or merge.
Do not put credentials, TLS material, private endpoint data, or runtime logs in the plan evidence.

delegations.escalation_trigger: the planned sequence would execute Vault, broaden network access, or weaken the temporary-admin boundary

validation: offline contract checks cited but not rerun as live authorization
